channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.5.17
- Rebuilds the waveform as a fixed 30 fps scrolling history of real microphone loudness instead of replacing all 38 bars with every incoming audio chunk. - Preserves 37 prior bars per frame and appends one new RMS-derived level, eliminating the jumping, stuttering pattern while keeping the display audio-driven. - Calibrates the meter against the saved real-voice reference recording on this Mac rather than synthetic test tones. - Keeps normal recorded speech centered around a restrained visual range with substantial headroom for genuinely forceful speech. - Adds a packaged real-voice regression diagnostic that checks both raw levels and the final rendered waveform against saturation limits.

# Kiki 0.5.16
- Raises the live waveform capture cadence from roughly 12 updates per second to roughly 47 on a typical 48 kHz microphone, eliminating the visible stepping between buffers. - Recalibrates the waveform meter with RMS-led analysis and additional headroom so ordinary speech no longer looks like clipping or shouting. - Retunes attack and release smoothing for the higher update rate, keeping motion fluid while remaining directly driven by microphone samples. - Adds regression checks for capture cadence, normal-speech headroom, forceful-speech range, silence, and deterministic sample tracking.

# Kiki 0.5.15
- Replaces the synthetic Listening Display animation with a waveform derived directly from each microphone sample buffer. - Divides incoming audio into 38 real time windows so the visible peaks and quiet regions follow the captured sound. - Removes autonomous sine motion, idle pulsing, scrolling history, and delayed decay that made the display appear disconnected from speech. - Keeps only restrained per-frame attack and release smoothing while preserving the transparent light/dark presentation. - Adds regression diagnostics for silence, deterministic output, and localized audio pulses.

# Kiki 0.5.14
- Makes Waveform mode fully transparent so the animated signal floats without a panel, border, or box shadow. - Adds a flat adaptive keyline behind each bar to keep the waveform readable over both light and dark content. - Leaves Full Transcript and status messages contained for readability. - Adds a regression check that keeps the Waveform surface transparent and prevents the adaptive keyline from disappearing.

# Kiki 0.5.13
- Replaces the Listening Display's seven-dot meter with a wide, animated 38-bar waveform. - Uses a logarithmic microphone meter so quiet and conversational speech create visible movement instead of remaining nearly flat. - Adds fast attack, natural decay, scrolling history, and a restrained sage-to-khaki live edge. - Keeps Waveform mode compact while making its response clearly readable in both light and dark appearances. - Adds signal-response diagnostics and a dedicated packaged waveform preview for visual release checks.
